questions.stem_text: In what sense might exceptionalism link isolationist and internationalist strategies?

options.B: Both focus on the decline of the American power
options.C: It doesn't - the two are fundamentally opposed
options.D: Both can be viewed as different means of achieving the same liberal ends

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Both can be viewed as different means of achieving the same liberal ends

questions.stem_text:
How did the relationship between President and Congress develop under George H.W. Bush and
Bill Clinton?

options.A: Congress asserted its primacy in foreign policy
options.B: US foreign policy became substantially decentralized
options.C: The Presidency welcomed the influence of Congress

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - None of the above

questions.stem_text:
What, according to Systemic theories, is the primary determinant of a state's foreign
policy?

options.A: The character of a state's leader
options.B: The distribution of power in the international system
options.C: The distribution of power within a state's governmental system

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - The distribution of power in the international system
